snippet.title: Pirate Cove Simulator available on Steam on 21 July 2025 #steam #gaming #games #trailer
snippet.description:
Check out Pirate Cove Simulator on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3290660/Pirate_Cove_Simulator

Pirate Cove Simulator will have you run a shop and tavern on the Island of the Damned, to get rich and buy your way out of the pirate afterlife. Trade with restless undead pirates, run your own distillery and turn local plants into potent drinks, search for hidden treasures, or just go fishing.
